s: Hello everyone, and welcome back to Word Kitchen!
Today we are talking about travel and transport.
We have fifteen new words for you, and we will use them in a fun travel story.
So, where are we going today?
We are going on a journey!
A journey is a long trip from one place to another.
Our journey starts at the train station.
A station is the building where trains stop.
Our first word, train, is a long vehicle that carries people on rails.
So we are at the station, and we are taking the train.
Before we get on the train, we need a ticket.
A ticket is a small paper you buy to travel.
Maya, do you have your ticket?
And I have my luggage too.
Luggage is the bags you carry when you travel.
My luggage is very heavy today.
I packed only one small bag.
Oh no, look at the big clock in the station.
Departure means the time you leave a place.
Our departure is at ten o'clock.
And what time is our arrival?
Arrival is the time you come to a place.
Our arrival is at one in the afternoon.
We will be on the train for three hours.
Three hours is a long time.
Let me look at the map.
A map is a picture that shows roads and places.
The map says we will cross a big river.
Oh, and we will go over a bridge!
A bridge is a road over a river.
I love looking out the window when the train goes over a bridge.
Wait, what platform are we on?
A platform is the raised area where you wait for a train.
We are on platform two, but the train is not here yet.
I can see the station is very busy.
Many people are waiting with their luggage.
Do you have your passport, Lena?
A passport is the small book that lets you travel to other countries.
For a train in this country, I do not need my passport.
But I always carry it when I travel.
It is good to have it.
Oh look, the train is coming!
Let's go to the platform door.
Wow, the train is so long.
My ticket says seat number twelve.
My ticket says seat number thirteen.
Here is the journey part, Lena.
I like the start of a journey.
Where will we sleep tonight, Maya?
A hotel is a building where travellers sleep and pay for rooms.
Our hotel is near the station in the new city.
Will we be a guest there?
A guest is a person staying at a hotel.
Yes, we will be guests at the hotel for two nights.
Then we take the bus to the mountains.
A bus is a big vehicle that carries many people on the road.
Is the bus station far from our hotel?
A taxi is a car with a driver that you pay to take you somewhere.
A taxi is fast, and our luggage is heavy.
Wow, the river is so beautiful.
The train is moving slowly over the bridge.
I can see boats on the water.
Let's use our words one more time, Maya.
A journey is a long trip.
A train carries people on rails.
A station is where trains stop.
A ticket is the paper you buy to travel.
A map shows roads and places.
A hotel is where travellers sleep.
A guest stays at a hotel.
A passport lets you travel to other countries.
A taxi is a car with a driver you pay.
Arrival is when you come to a place.
A platform is where you wait for the train.
A bus carries many people on the road.
And a bridge is a road over a river.
Practice them on your next trip.
What is the most important thing for a good journey?
I think it is a good map, a light bag of luggage, and a comfortable hotel at the end of the day.
And do not forget your ticket before the departure, or the train will leave without you!
I once missed my bus because I forgot the time of departure.
Now I always check my ticket two times.
When you travel by taxi, the driver can take you straight to the hotel door.
And at the hotel, the guest room is waiting.
You give your name, you get a key, and your journey for the day is done.
Then tomorrow, a new bus, a new bridge, and a new adventure.
Travel is the best way to learn new words.
Okay, now we are really finished.
Practice these words with a friend and plan your own journey.
Thanks for listening to Word Kitchen.
